description:
A voice-driven mouse navigation system using clock-position metaphors. Say a clock direction (e.g., "3 o'clock") and the mouse moves in that direction by a configurable step size.

## Existing Hooks
The repeater system already references mouse clock actions:
- user.mouse_clock_move_opposite — move in the reverse direction
- user.mouse_clock_move_original — move in the original direction
- Clock directions mapped to letters_colors captures
- "circle_answer" capture for ring/clock mode
- "mouse clock" is in excluded_commands.csv for repeater

## Concept
- 12 clock positions (1-12) map to 30-degree increments around current mouse position
- Voice command: "clock <number>" moves mouse in that direction
- Configurable step size (distance per move)
- Repeatable via the repeater system ("again" repeats last clock move)
- "reverse" moves in the opposite clock direction
- Could also support letter-based shortcuts (a=1, b=2, etc.) based on the letters_colors captures

## Location
trillium/plugin/mouse_clock/ (new plugin directory)

## Files to Create
- mouse_clock.py — core logic (direction calculation, mouse movement)
- mouse_clock.talon — voice commands
- Optional: mouse_clock_settings.talon for configuration
title: Build mouse clock navigation plugin
